surface_mechanism_description: The growth mechanism involves the simultaneous introduction of O2 and NH3 plasma into the ALD chamber to control the oxygen and nitrogen composition. The growth rate, composition, and optical properties of the GaOxNy film are influenced by the O2:NH3 ratio. The surface reactions are likely to involve the interaction of the Ga precursor (tris(dimethylamino)silane, TMG) with O2 and NH3 plasma, leading to the formation of Ga-O and Ga-N bonds, as well as surface hydroxyl groups and nitrogen-containing species.
evidence: The surface reactions and mechanisms were discussed in the context of the ALD process, where O2 and NH3 plasma were introduced simultaneously. The XPS analysis indicated the presence of Ga-O, Ga-N, and N-Ga-O bonds, suggesting the involvement of surface hydroxyl groups and nitrogen-containing species during the growth process. The growth behavior was optimized by adjusting the O2:NH3 ratio, indicating the dynamic interaction between the precursors and the surface.
